ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r1.claim: Affluent leaders of Makkah and Ṭāʾif mistook wealth for proof that they were God's favorites and expected still more; Muhammad should leave their fate to God.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r1.anchor: These verses admonish the megalomaniac leaders of Makkah

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r4.claim: The passage describes a general wealthy, high-status mentality, not Walīd ibn Mughīrah alone, though it applies to him too.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p41/r4.anchor: there is no reason for restricting the verse to him

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p42/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p42/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p42/r3.claim: The bestowed wealth was spread across different locations and ventures, like modern capitalists' international accounts and investments.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p42/r3.anchor: in every country and investments in companies found all over the world

RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r1.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r1.claim: ʿUmar explains extended wealth as a continuing inflow, arriving month after month.
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r1.anchor: فلذلك فسره عمر بن الخطاب بغلة شهر شهر

RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r2.claim: Another meaning is wealth continually extended by increase, such as livestock, crops, and kinds of trade.

RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās describes al-Walīd’s wealth as physically extensive from Mecca to al-Ṭāʾif: camels, horses, sheep, many gardens, trees, rivers, and abundant money.
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r3.anchor: قال ابن عباس : كان ماله ممدودا ما بين مكة إلى الطائف

RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r4.speaker: مقاتل
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r4.claim: Muqātil says al-Walīd had a garden whose benefit never stopped in winter or summer; extended here means unending, as with the extended shade in 56:30.
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r4.anchor: وقال مقاتل : كان له بستان لا ينقطع نفعه شتاء ولا صيفا

RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r5.claim: A further explanation is simply abundant wealth, whose enumeration would extend at length.
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r5.anchor: أنه المال الكثير وذلك لأن المال الكثير إذا عدد فإنه يمتد تعديده

RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r6.speaker: بعض المفسرين
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r6.claim: Some commentators estimate it at one thousand dinars, others at four thousand, and others at one million.

RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r7.claim: Rāzī dismisses these numerical estimates as arbitrary guesses that sound judgment does not favor.
RAZI-FULL:v30p175#2/r7.anchor: وهذه التحكمات مما لا يميل إليها الطبع السليم

STUDYQURAN:74:11/r6.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:11/r6.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:74:11/r6.claim: The verses are applied specifically to al-Walīd’s great wealth, seven or ten sons, learning, and eloquence among Quraysh.
STUDYQURAN:74:11/r6.anchor: These verses are said to refer specifically to the great fortune that God had bestowed upon al-Walīd, who was among the wealthiest men in Makkah

TAB-FULL:v23p422/r9.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p422/r9.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p422/r9.claim: Al-Ṭabarī notes disagreement over what this extended wealth was and how much it amounted to.
TAB-FULL:v23p422/r9.anchor: اختلف أهل التأويل في هذا المال الذي ذكره الله، وأخبر أنه جعله للوحيد ما هو، وما مبلغه

TAB-FULL:v23p422/r10.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p422/r10.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v23p422/r10.claim: Mujāhid says al-Walīd’s wealth amounted to one thousand dinars.
TAB-FULL:v23p422/r10.anchor: عن مجاهد: {وجعلت له مالا ممدودا} [المدثر: 12] قال: كان ماله ألف دينار

TAB-FULL:v23p423/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p423/r1.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
TAB-FULL:v23p423/r1.claim: Saʿīd ibn Jubayr says the extended wealth was one thousand dinars.
TAB-FULL:v23p423/r1.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير، في قوله: {وجعلت له مالا ممدودا} [المدثر: 12] قال: ألف دينار

TAB-FULL:v23p423/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p423/r2.speaker: سفيان
TAB-FULL:v23p423/r2.claim: Sufyān reports that he had heard the amount was four thousand dinars.
TAB-FULL:v23p423/r2.anchor: عن سفيان، {وجعلت له مالا ممدودا} [المدثر: 12] قال: بلغني أنه أربعة آلاف دينار

TAB-FULL:v23p423/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p423/r3.speaker: النعمان بن سالم
TAB-FULL:v23p423/r3.claim: Al-Nuʿmān ibn Sālim identifies the wealth as land.
TAB-FULL:v23p423/r3.anchor: عن النعمان بن سالم، في قوله: {وجعلت له مالا ممدودا} [المدثر: 12] قال: الأرض

TAB-FULL:v23p423/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p423/r4.speaker: عطاء
TAB-FULL:v23p423/r4.claim: ʿAṭāʾ says it was income received month by month; some routes attribute this report to ʿUmar, while others omit him.
TAB-FULL:v23p423/r4.anchor: عن عطاء، عن عمر رضي الله عنه في قوله: {وجعلت له مالا ممدودا} [المدثر: 12] قال: غلة شهر بشهر

TAB-FULL:v23p423/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p423/r5.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p423/r5.claim: Al-Ṭabarī prefers the broad sense stated by God: abundant wealth, extended in its number or in its area.
TAB-FULL:v23p423/r5.anchor: والصواب من القول في ذلك أن يقال كما قال الله

TABATABAI:74:12-25/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:12-25/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:12-25/r1.claim: Mamdūd means either abundant and extended wealth or wealth extended through growth.
TABATABAI:74:12-25/r1.anchor: أي مبسوطا كثيرا أو ممدودا بمدد النماء

BURSEVI:v10p175#2/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p175#2/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p175#2/r5.claim: Mamdūd means abundant, extended wealth, including varied properties and produce between Mecca and Ṭāʾif.
BURSEVI:v10p175#2/r5.anchor: أي مبسوط أكثيرا وهو ما كان له بين مكة ولطائف

BURSEVI:v10p175#2/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p175#2/r6.speaker: النوري
BURSEVI:v10p175#2/r6.claim: Al-Nūrī reports that al-Walīd owned one million dinars.
BURSEVI:v10p175#2/r6.anchor: وقال النوري كان له ألف ألف دينار

BURSEVI:v10p176/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p176/r1.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
BURSEVI:v10p176/r1.claim: The Najmī allusion makes al-Walīd the solitary evil soul; his wealth, bad traits, followers, and prestige symbolize sins and the dark natural powers of a rebellious self.
BURSEVI:v10p176/r1.anchor: وفي التأويلات النجمية : يشير إلى الوليد بن مغيرة

BURSEVI:v10p176/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p176/r2.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
BURSEVI:v10p176/r2.claim: Abū Bakr the hidden, ʿUmar the spirit, ʿUthmān the secret, and ʿAlī the heart use spiritual light to erase the self’s darkness, defeat its deeds and followers, and end its dominion.
BURSEVI:v10p176/r2.anchor: يعني دعني وإياه فإني أسلط عليه أبا بكر الخفي وعمر الروح وعثمان السر وعلى القلب

TABRISI:74:11-31/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:11-31/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
TABRISI:74:11-31/r8.claim: ʿAṭāʾ from Ibn ʿAbbas describes wealth from Mecca to Ṭāʾif: herds, fine horses and livestock, enduring revenues, enslaved people, and abundant cash.
TABRISI:74:11-31/r8.anchor: النعم المرحلة والمستغلات التي لا تنقطع غلتها والجواري والعبيد والعين الكثيرة عن عطاء عن ابن عباس

TABRISI:74:11-31/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:11-31/r9.speaker: مجاهد
TABRISI:74:11-31/r9.claim: Mujahid says the wealth’s yield never stopped from year to year; al-Walid had a productive Taʾif orchard, ten sons, and one hundred thousand dinars.
TABRISI:74:11-31/r9.anchor: وكان له بستان بالطائف لا ينقطع خيره في شتاء ولا صيف وعشرة بنين ومائة ألف دينار عن مجاهد

TABRISI:74:11-31/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:11-31/r10.speaker: قتادة
TABRISI:74:11-31/r10.claim: Qatada estimates al-Walid’s wealth at six thousand dinars.
TABRISI:74:11-31/r10.anchor: وقيل: ستة آلاف دينار عن قتادة

TABRISI:74:11-31/r11.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:11-31/r11.speaker: سفيان
TABRISI:74:11-31/r11.claim: Sufyan estimates al-Walid’s wealth at four thousand dinars.
TABRISI:74:11-31/r11.anchor: وقيل: أربعة آلاف دينار عن سفيان

TABRISI:74:11-31/r15.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:11-31/r15.speaker: قيل
TABRISI:74:11-31/r15.claim: The report says al-Walid’s wealth and children continued to decline after this passage until his death.
TABRISI:74:11-31/r15.anchor: قالوا فما زال الوليد بعد هذه الآية في نقصان من ماله وولده حتى هلك

THALABI:v10p71/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p71/r1.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p71/r1.claim: The extended wealth means a great amount.
THALABI:v10p71/r1.anchor: وجعلت له مالا ممدودا أي كثيرا

THALABI:v10p71/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p71/r2.speaker: قيل
THALABI:v10p71/r2.claim: An alternative takes the wealth as assets that keep growing, such as crops, livestock produce, and trade.
THALABI:v10p71/r2.anchor: وقيل: ما يمد بالنماء كالزرع والضرع والتجارة واختلفوا في مبلغه.

THALABI:v10p71/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p71/r3.speaker: مجاهد وسعيد بن جبير
THALABI:v10p71/r3.claim: They estimate al-Walid's wealth at one thousand dinars.
THALABI:v10p71/r3.anchor: فقال: مجاهد وسعيد بن جبير: ألف دينار. قتادة: أربعة آلاف دينار.

THALABI:v10p71/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p71/r4.speaker: قتادة
THALABI:v10p71/r4.claim: Qatada estimates the wealth at four thousand dinars.
THALABI:v10p71/r4.anchor: ألف دينار. قتادة: أربعة آلاف دينار. سفيان الثوري: ألف ألف.

THALABI:v10p71/r5.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p71/r5.speaker: سفيان الثوري
THALABI:v10p71/r5.claim: Sufyan al-Thawri estimates it at one million.
THALABI:v10p71/r5.anchor: قتادة: أربعة آلاف دينار. سفيان الثوري: ألف ألف.

THALABI:v10p71/r6.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p71/r6.speaker: النعمان بن سالم
THALABI:v10p71/r6.claim: Al-Nuʿman ibn Salim says his wealth consisted of land.
THALABI:v10p71/r6.anchor: سفيان الثوري: ألف ألف. النعمان بن سالم: كان ماله أرضا.

THALABI:v10p71/r7.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p71/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
THALABI:v10p71/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas gives the amount as seven thousand silver mithqals.
THALABI:v10p71/r7.anchor: النعمان بن سالم: كان ماله أرضا. ابن عباس: سبعة آلاف مثقال فضة.

THALABI:v10p71/r8.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p71/r8.speaker: مقاتل
THALABI:v10p71/r8.claim: Mujahid says al-Walid owned an everbearing garden at Taif, fruiting in winter and summer; its evidence is the phrase “and extended shade.”
THALABI:v10p71/r8.anchor: مقاتل: كان له بستانا بالطائف لا ينقطع ثماره شتاء ولا صيفا، دليله

THALABI:v10p71/r9.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p71/r9.speaker: عمر
THALABI:v10p71/r9.claim: In a report carried by Ibn Jurayj from ʿAta, ʿUmar explains the wealth as income arriving month by month.
THALABI:v10p71/r9.anchor: وروى ابن جريح عن عطاء عن عمر في قوله سبحانه: وجعلت له مالا ممدودا قال: غلة شهر. بشهر.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r9.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r9.speaker: ابن عباس عن أبي صالح
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r9.claim: Ibn Abbas, in the report from Abu Salih, glosses it as abundant wealth of every kind.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r9.anchor: قال ابن عباس (في رواية أبي صالح)

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r10.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r10.speaker: ابن عباس عن عطاء
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r10.claim: In the report from ʿAta, Ibn Abbas lists camels and branded horses between Mecca and Taif, livestock, Taif orchards, plentiful cash, slaves, and concubines.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r10.anchor: وفسره في رواية عطاء فقال: "مالا ممدودا" ما بين مكة إلى الطائف الإبل

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r11.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r11.speaker: مقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r11.claim: Muqatil identifies it as al-Walid’s garden in Taif, whose yield continued in winter and summer, like the unceasing shade in 56:30.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r11.anchor: وقال مقاتل: يعني بستانه الذي بالطائف، كان لا ينقطع خيره، شتاء ولا صيفا

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r12.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r12.speaker: مجاهد وسعيد بن جبير
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r12.claim: Mujahid and Saʿid ibn Jubayr estimate the wealth at one thousand dinars.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p415#2/r12.anchor: ومن المفسرين من عين قدر ذلك المال، فروي عن مجاهد

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r1.speaker: قتادة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r1.claim: Qatada estimates al-Walid’s wealth at four thousand dinars.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r2.speaker: الثوري
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r2.claim: Al-Thawri estimates it at one million dinars.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r3.claim: Al-Wahidi prefers wealth that keeps growing and replenishing, such as crops, livestock, and trade.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r3.anchor: والأولى في الممدود أن يكون ما يمد بالزيادة والنماء، كالزرع

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r4.speaker: أبو إسحاق
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r4.claim: Abu Ishaq says the wealth did not cease to yield.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r4.anchor: قال أبو إسحاق: تفسيره غير منقطع عنه

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r5.speaker: عمر
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r5.claim: Umar explains the extended wealth as income accruing from month to month.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r5.anchor: دليله ما روي عن عمر أنه قال في تفسيره: هو غلة شهر بشهر

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r6.speaker: أهل المعاني
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r6.claim: The description mamdūd implies successive support arriving one thing after another.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p420/r6.anchor: وقال أهل المعاني: وصفه بأنه ممدود يقتضي هذا المعنى، وهو أن يكون له مدد يأتي شيئا بعد شيء

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:11-19/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:11-19/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:11-19/r2.claim: His wealth was continuous and abundant from crops, livestock, and trade.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:11-19/r2.anchor: دائما لا ينقطع عنه من الزرع والضرع والتجارة

ELMALILI:74:5-12/r19.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:74:5-12/r19.speaker: author
ELMALILI:74:5-12/r19.claim: Mamdud means extended or abundant wealth, including property and estates, or wealth continually increased by growth or trade.
ELMALILI:74:5-12/r19.anchor: uzun uzadıya uzatılmış, yani çok mal, servet, arazi ve çiftlik gibi geniş yahut nemâ ile veya ticaret ile artırılmış uzatılmış

ELMALILI:74:5-12/r20.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:74:5-12/r20.speaker: author
ELMALILI:74:5-12/r20.claim: Reports describe al-Walid as owning extensive assets between Mecca and Taif, an all-season fruit garden in Taif, and roughly a million coins.
ELMALILI:74:5-12/r20.anchor: Velîd’in Mekke ile Tâif arasında türlü emvâli ve Tâif’te yaz kış meyveleri eksik olmayan bostanı ve milyon kadar nukūdu bulunduğuna dair rivayetler nakledilmiştir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r2.claim: Al-Walīd was a wealthy Quraysh notable with many sons, yet instead of thanking God for His gifts he was ungrateful to God and the Prophet and led efforts to suppress Islam.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r2.anchor: Velîd, Kureyş’in ileri gelenlerinden olup çok sayıda oğulları vardı ve oldukça zengindi; buna rağmen Allah’ın kendisine lutfettiği nimetlere şükredecek yerde

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r5.claim: The passage’s general lesson is that gratitude to the giver of blessings is a basic moral duty grounded in reason and justice.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r5.anchor: Nimete karşı şükretmek, nimet sahibine minnettar olmak en yalın ahlâkî ödevlerden biri, akıl ve adalet gereğidir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r6.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r6.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r6.claim: Failing to thank God for life and material and spiritual gifts is grave ingratitude, especially when it advances denial, polytheism, and injustice.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:11/r6.anchor: varlığımızı, hayatımızı, sahip olduğumuz, yararlandığımız her türlü maddî ve mânevî nimet ve imkânları lutfeden Allah’a minnettar olmamak, şükretmemek

QUSHAYRI:v3p363/r20.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p363/r20.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p363/r20.claim: God gave him abundant, extended wealth.
QUSHAYRI:v3p363/r20.anchor: وجعلت له مالا ممدودا وبنين شهودا

TUSTARI:74:12/r1.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:74:12/r1.speaker: author
TUSTARI:74:12/r1.claim: The person given extended wealth is al-Walid ibn al-Mughira; what God extended to him was greed and long expectation.
TUSTARI:74:12/r1.anchor: يعني الوليد بن المغيرة، جعلت له الحرص وطول الأمل

DAMGHANI:v1p428/r8.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p428/r8.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p428/r8.claim: Mamdūd can mean something without end; the source says this applies to the wealth granted to the person in this verse.
DAMGHANI:v1p428/r8.anchor: الثالث : المد ما لا انقطاع له . كقوله تعالى فى سورة الواقعة (( وظل ممدود )) . مثلها فى سورة المدثر (( وجعلت له مالا ممدودا ))

DAMGHANI:v1p428/r9.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p428/r9.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p428/r9.claim: The five listed senses of madd also include spreading and leveling, though this excerpt gives no examples for those two senses.
DAMGHANI:v1p428/r9.anchor: م د د على خمسة أوجه العطاء . الإلجاء . ما لا انقطاع له . البسط . التسوية

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p496#3/r2.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p496#3/r2.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p496#3/r2.claim: His extended wealth was lasting or continuous.

ZAJJAJ:v5p246/r8.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p246/r8.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p246/r8.claim: The wealth is described as continuing without interruption; another report specifies one thousand dinars.
ZAJJAJ:v5p246/r8.anchor: تقديره مال غير منقطع عنه، وقيل ألف دينار

ZAJJAJ:v5p246/r10.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p246/r10.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p246/r10.claim: The passage is said to refer to al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīra, who had ten sons and was wealthy.
ZAJJAJ:v5p246/r10.anchor: وهذا قيل يعنى به الوليد بن المغيرة، كان له بنون عشرة وكان موسرا

ASAD-NOTES:74:11/r2.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:74:11/r2.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:74:11/r2.anchor: to whom I have granted resources vast

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p62/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p62/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p62/r1.claim: Meccan opponents repeatedly alleged that the Quran was human fabrication, borrowed ancient lore, or material copied from earlier writings and dictated to Muhammad; the Quran records these charges and reasons against their falsehood.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p62/r1.anchor: ويسجل القرآن مفترياتهم لا يكتمها، ويجادلهم فيها بما يهدي كل ذي عقل وبصيرة

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r1.claim: Al-Muddaththir is the counterpart of the preceding al-Muzzammil; their central themes are essentially the same and their names share a meaning.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r1.anchor: There is no essential difference between the central themes of both sūrahs .

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r6.claim: Verses 11–17 warn that Judgment Day will be severe for disbelievers who presume their wealth and rank will bring them still more.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r6.anchor: The Prophet (sws) should well inform the people about the afflictions of the Day of Judgement.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r8.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r8.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r8.claim: God later bestowed wealth and status, but instead of gratitude the man became conceited and vain.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p31/r8.anchor: conceit and vanity overcame them and they held that whatever they had was their right by birth

IBNHISHAM:v1p270/r1.author: Ibn Hishām
IBNHISHAM:v1p270/r1.speaker: الوليد بن المغيرة
IBNHISHAM:v1p270/r1.claim: At the pilgrimage season, Quraysh ask al-Walid for a single story about Muhammad; after rejecting soothsayer, madman, poet, and sorcerer as accurate descriptions, he recommends calling him a sorcerer because people see him as dividing families.
IBNHISHAM:v1p270/r1.anchor: ثم إن الوليد بن المغيرة اجتمع إليه نفر من قريش، وكان ذا سن فيهم، وقد حضر الموسم

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p329#3/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p329#3/r1.speaker: مجاهد
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p329#3/r1.claim: Mujāhid says the extended wealth was one thousand dinars.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p329#3/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله تعالى ﴿ مالا ممدودا ﴾ قال ألف دينار

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r8.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says al-Walīd had camels, livestock, gardens, and male and female slaves between Mecca and Ṭāʾif.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r8.anchor: قال ابن عباس: كان له بين مكة والطائف إبل وحجور ونعم وجنان وعبيد وجوار.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r9.claim: Another view describes him as an owner of crops, livestock, and trade.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r9.anchor: وقيل: كان صاحب زرع وضرع وتجارة.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r10.speaker: النعمان بن بشير
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r10.claim: Al-Nuʿmān ibn Bashīr interprets the extended wealth as land because it stretches out.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r10.anchor: وقال النعمان بن بشير: المال المدود هو الأرض لأنها مدت.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r11.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r11.claim: ʿUmar says it is recurring monthly income, extended over time without ceasing.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r11.anchor: وقال عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه: هو الريع المستغل مشاهرة، فهو مد في الزمان لا ينقطع.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r12.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r12.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r12.claim: Proposed exact values range from one thousand to one million dinars; the author calls these figures conjecture.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r12.anchor: وقيل: هو مقدار معين واضطربوا في تعيينه. فما قيل: ألف دينار، وقيل: ألف ألف دينار، وكل هذا تحكم.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r17.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r17.speaker: مقاتل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r17.claim: Muqātil says al-Walīd’s wealth and children declined after revelation until his death.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p328/r17.anchor: قال مقاتل: فما زال الوليد بعد هذه الآية وبعد نزولها في نقص في ماله وولده حتى هلك

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r1.claim: “Mamdūd” can mean abundant, or extended like a river enlarged by a tributary; other descriptions emphasize the man’s many resources.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r1.anchor: مبسوطا كثيرا أو ممدودا بالنساء منمد النهر ومده نهر آخر

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r2.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r2.claim: One account describes his property as livestock, crops, and commerce.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r2.anchor: وقيل كان له الضرع والزرع والتجارة

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says his holdings between Mecca and Ṭāʾif included camels, property, orchards, and servants.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r3.anchor: وعن ابن عباس وهو ما كان له بين مكة والطائف من الأبل والنعل والجنان والعبيد

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r4.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r4.claim: Another report says he had an orchard at Ṭāʾif whose fruit continued through summer and winter.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r4.anchor: وقيل له بستان بالطائف لا تنقطع ثماره صيفا وشتاء

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r5.speaker: النعمان بن بشير
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r5.claim: Al-Nuʿmān b. Bashīr is cited for interpreting the extended wealth as the spread-out earth.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r5.anchor: وقال النعمان بن بشير المال الممدود

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r6.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r6.claim: ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb glosses it as income collected month after month, so it does not run out.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r6.anchor: وعن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله تعالى عنه أنه المستغل الذي يجبي شهرا بعد شهر فهو ممدود لا ينقطع

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r7.speaker: ابن عباس ومجاهد وابن جبير
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās, Mujāhid, and Ibn Jubayr report that al-Walīd had one thousand dinars.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r7.anchor: وعن ابن عباس ومجاهد وابن جبير كان له ألف دينار

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r8.speaker: قتادة
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r8.claim: Qatādah gives the amount as six thousand dinars.

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r9.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r9.claim: An unnamed report gives nine thousand dinars.

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r10.speaker: سفيان الثوري
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r10.claim: Sufyān al-Thawrī is cited with two transmitted figures: four thousand dinars and a second wording of “a thousand and a thousand.”
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r10.anchor: وعن سفيان الثوري روايتان أربعة آلاف دينار وألف وألف دينار

ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r11.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r11.claim: These figures, if authentic, do not define the intended amount; they illustrate how great his wealth was relative to the person being addressed.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p122/r11.anchor: وهذه الأقوال إن صحت ليست المراد بها تعيين المال والممدود وانه متى أطلق يراد به ذلك بل بيان أنه كان بالنسبة إلى المحدث عنه كذا

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r10.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r10.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r10.claim: Mamdūd means abundant wealth, possibly wealth that grows through crops, livestock, and trade.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r10.anchor: {وجعلت له مالا ممدودا} أي: كثيرا. قيل: هو ما يمد بالنماء كالزرع والضرع والتجارة.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r11.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r11.speaker: مجاهد وسعيد بن جبير
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r11.claim: Mujahid and Said ibn Jubayr estimate his wealth at one thousand dinars.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r11.anchor: قال مجاهد وسعيد بن جبير: ألف دينار.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r12.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r12.speaker: قتادة
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r12.claim: Qatada estimates the wealth at four thousand dinars.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r13.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r13.speaker: سفيان الثوري
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r13.claim: Sufyan al-Thawri estimates the wealth at one million dinars.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r14.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r14.speaker: ابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r14.claim: Ibn Abbas estimates the wealth at nine thousand mithqals of silver.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r14.anchor: وقال ابن عباس: تسعة آلاف مثقال فضة.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r15.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r15.speaker: مقاتل
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r15.claim: Muqatil says he owned a garden at Taif whose fruit never ceased in winter or summer.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r15.anchor: وقال مقاتل: كان له بستان بالطائف لا تنقطع ثماره شتاء ولا صيفا.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r16.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r16.speaker: عطاء عن ابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r16.claim: Ata from Ibn Abbas describes livestock, caravans, servants, and male and female slaves between Mecca and Taif.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r16.anchor: وقال عطاء عن ابن عباس: كان له بين مكة والطائف إبل وخيل ونعم

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r17.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r17.speaker: قيل
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r17.claim: Another explanation is that he received income month after month.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p266/r17.anchor: وقيل: مالا ممدودا غلة شهر بشهر

BAYDAWI-FULL:74:11-13/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:11-13/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:11-13/r6.claim: His wealth was abundant or continually growing; it included crops, livestock, and trade.
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:11-13/r6.anchor: مبسوطا كثيرا أو ممدا بالنماء، وكان له الزرع والضرع والتجارة

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالتثنية)#581/r1.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالتثنية)#581/r1.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالتثنية)#581/r1.claim: Dual nouns take alif plus nūn in the nominative and yāʾ plus nūn in the accusative and genitive; ordinary non-defective, non-hamzated nouns form the dual by opening the final consonant.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالتثنية)#581/r1.anchor: اعلم أن التثنية تكون في الرفع بالألف والنون وفي النصب والجر بالياء

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: Triliteral nouns followed by the two feminine alifs retain the post-diminutive consonant and both alifs, as in ḥumayrāʾ and ṭurayfāʾ.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.anchor: لا تكسر الحرف الذي بعد ياء التصغير

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: Faʿlān nouns with a feminine faʿlā counterpart keep the nūn in diminutive because it follows an alif and substitutes for the feminine alif, like the hamza in ḥamrāʾ.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.anchor: ألف وكانت بدلا من ألف التأنيث حين أرادوا

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: A five-letter noun ending in nūn after alif, matching faʿlān but not broken on mafāʿīl, takes the same diminutive pattern as faʿlān/faʿlā.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.anchor: حروف فعلان الذي له فعلى توالت فيه ثلاث حركات

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: A declinable triliteral noun with two added letters and a long hamza diminutivizes like a same-length noun whose hamza replaces a root yāʾ, as ʿalbay and ḥurayb.

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: Where the replaced root yāʾ is visible, the diminutive keeps it, as in daraḥiya → durayḥiya, because the added letters are not feminine markers.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.anchor: حقرت ذلك الاسم كما تحقر الاسم الذي ظهرت فيه ياء

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: من قال غوغاء
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: Those treating ghawghāʾ as masculine and declinable like qaḍqāḍ form its diminutive ghwayghī.

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: من لم يصرف وأنث
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: Those treating ghawghāʾ as feminine and indeclinable form ghwayghāʾ, on the pattern of ʿuwayrāʾ.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.anchor: ومن لم يصرف وأنث فإنها عنده بمنزلة عوراء

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: من قال قوباء
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: A speaker who declines masculine qūbāʾ forms quwaybī, like ʿalbay.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.anchor: ومن قال قوباء فصرف قال قويبي كما تقول عليبي

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: من قال هذه قوباء
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: A speaker treating qūbāʾ as feminine and indeclinable forms quwaybāʾ, like ḥumayrāʾ, because it has the feminine alifs on a triliteral base.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.anchor: فأنث ولم يصرف قال قويباء كما قال حميراء

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: A faʿlān noun broken on mafāʿīl takes a diminutive like sirbāl because its broken plural governs the treatment; examples include sarḥān, ḍabʿān, ḥawmān, sulṭān, and farzān.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.anchor: شبهوه به حيث كسر للجمع كما يكسر سربال

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: من قال فرازنة
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: Those pluralizing farzān as farāzina still use furayziyyīn in diminutive, since it has a broken plural like jaḥājiḥa and zanādiqa.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.anchor: فريزيين لأنه قد كسر كما كسر جحجاح وزنديق

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: Ẓarbān becomes ẓuraybān because its plural ẓarābī drops the nūn, unlike sirbāl’s retained root lām; treat its plural as ẓarbāʾ.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.anchor: كأنك كسرته على ظرباء ولم تكسره على ظربان

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: Warshān is diminished as warayshiyyīn because its plural is warāshīn.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.anchor: وتقول في ورشان وريشيين لأنك تقول وراشين

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: If a sarḥān-like noun has no known broken plural, use the faʿlān/faʿlā diminutive by analogy until its plural is known.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.anchor: إذا جاء شيء على عدة حروف سرحان وآخره كآخر سرحان

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: يونس وأبو عمرو
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: Yūnus and Abū ʿAmr give sarḥān → surayḥīn; proper-name diminutives retain this pattern.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.anchor: ولو سميت رجلا بسرحان فحقرته لقلت سريحين

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: Proper names such as ʿalqā and maʿzā take ʿulayqī and muʿayzī, while a woman named sirbāl takes suraybāl; diminutive formation stays regular even when the name is indeclinable.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.anchor: ولو قلت سريحان لقلت في رجل يسمى علقى عليقي

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.speaker: يونس
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابتصغيرماكانعلىثلاثةأحرفول.claim: Sībawayh attributes the material in this chapter and the next to Yūnus.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r5.claim: God made the man’s wealth vast, growing, abundant, and available throughout his life; its provision came from God, not the man’s own power.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r5.anchor: مالا ممدودا * } أي مبسوطا واسعا ناميا كثيرا جدا عاما لجميع أوقات وجوده

BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r6.claim: The wealthy man intended here is al-Walid ibn al-Mughira.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r6.anchor: والمراد به كما يأتي الوليد بن المغيرة

BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r7.claim: Ibn Abbas says al-Walid owned camels, livestock, gardens, enslaved men and women, and other property between Mecca and Taif.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p224/r7.anchor: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما : كان له بين مكة والطائف إبل وحجور ونعم وجنان وعبيد وجوار

DURR-FULL:v8p329/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r3.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r3.claim: Mujahid says the extended wealth was one thousand dinars.
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r3.anchor: عن مجاهد {ذرني ومن خلقت وحيدا} قال: نزلت في الوليد بن المغيرة

DURR-FULL:v8p329/r14.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r14.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r14.claim: Ibn Abbas says the extended wealth was one thousand dinars.
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r14.anchor: عن ابن عباس {وجعلت له مالا ممدودا} قال: ألف دينار

DURR-FULL:v8p329/r15.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r15.speaker: سفيان
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r15.claim: Sufyan says the extended wealth was one million.
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r15.anchor: عن سفيان {وجعلت له مالا ممدودا} قال: ألف ألف

DURR-FULL:v8p329/r16.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r16.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r16.claim: Umar ibn al-Khattab glosses the wealth as monthly income accrued month by month.
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r16.anchor: عن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه أنه سئل عن قوله: {وجعلت له مالا ممدودا} قال: غلة شهر بشهر

DURR-FULL:v8p329/r17.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r17.speaker: النعمان بن سالم
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r17.claim: Al-Nuʿman ibn Salim says the extended wealth means land.
DURR-FULL:v8p329/r17.anchor: عن النعمان بن سالم في قوله: {وجعلت له مالا ممدودا} قال: الأرض

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3382#4/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3382#4/r3.speaker: مجاهد
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3382#4/r3.claim: Mujahid interprets the extended wealth as one thousand dinars.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3382#4/r3.anchor: وجعلت له مالا ممدودا قال : الف دينار

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3382#4/r12.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3382#4/r12.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3382#4/r12.claim: ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb says the extended wealth was income received month by month.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3382#4/r12.anchor: عن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه انه سئل عن قوله : وجعلت له مالا ممدودا قال : غلة شهر بشهر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r1.claim: ‘I gave him wealth’ is joined as a specific blessing after the general blessing of creating him.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r1.anchor: وعطف على ذلك { وجعلت له مالا } عطف الخاص على العام .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r2.claim: One reading derives mamdūd from madd, ‘lengthen’: abundant wealth is likened to an expanse of bodily size.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r2.anchor: والممدود : اسم مفعول من مد الذي بمعنى : أطال ، بأن شبهت كثرة المال

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r3.claim: Alternatively, mamdūd derives from madd, ‘increase a thing by its like’: earnings continually add to his wealth.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r3.anchor: أو من مد الذي بمعنى : زاد في الشيء من مثله ، كما يقال : مد الوادي النهر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas says al-Walid's wealth between Mecca and Taif included livestock, enslaved people, and orchards, yielding one thousand dinars each year.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r4.anchor: وعن ابن عباس : كان مال الوليد بين مكة والطائف من الإبل والغنم والعبيد والجواري

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r11.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r11.claim: The blessings are recalled as a prelude to reproaching al-Walid and warning him of worldly harm and afterlife punishment.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r11.anchor: ووصف في هذه الآية بما له من النعمة والسعة لأن الآية في سياق الامتنان عليه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r12.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r12.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r12.claim: This contrasts with 68:10's account of his vices; that verse may concern al-Walid, but the identification is only a possibility, since its context warns against his harm and treachery.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p304/r12.anchor: فأما في آية سورة القلم فقد وصفه بما فيه من النقائص في قوله تعالى : { ولا تطع كل حلاف مهين }

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r5.speaker: مجاهد، ابن جبير
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r5.claim: Mujahid and Ibn Jubayr identify the extended wealth as one thousand dinars.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r5.anchor: قال مجاهد وابن جبير هو ألف دينار

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r6.speaker: سفيان، قتادة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r6.claim: Sufyan says he heard it was four thousand dinars, and Qatada gives the same figure.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r6.anchor: وقال سفيان: بلغني أنه أربعة آلاف دينار وقاله قتادة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r7.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r7.claim: Another reported estimate of the extended wealth is ten thousand dinars.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r7.anchor: وقيل: عشرة آلاف دينار، فهذا مد في العدد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r8.speaker: النعمان بن بشير
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r8.claim: Nu'man ibn Bashir says the wealth was land, extended in the sense of being spread out.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r8.anchor: وقال النعمان بن بشير هي الأرض لأنها مدت

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r9.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r9.claim: Umar identifies it as a productive estate yielding recurring monthly income, extended through time rather than amount.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p394/r9.anchor: وقال عمر بن الخطاب: المال الممدود الربع المستغل مشاهرة، فهو مد في الزمان لا ينقطع

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p404/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p404/r4.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p404/r4.claim: One report measures the wealth as monthly income, month after month.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p404/r4.anchor: أحدها غلة شهر بشهر قاله عمر بن الخطاب

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p404/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p404/r5.speaker: ابن عباس، مجاهد، ابن جبير
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p404/r5.claim: Another view puts it at one thousand dinars; al-Farrāʾ says a thousand marks the boundary where the count begins again.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p404/r5.anchor: والثاني ألف دينار قاله ابن عباس ومجاهد وابن جبير قال الفراء نرى أن الممدود جعل غاية للعدد لأن ألف غاية للعدد

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p404/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p404/r6.speaker: قتادة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p404/r6.claim: Qatāda gives the amount as four thousand.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p404/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p404/r7.speaker: قاتل
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p404/r7.claim: An alternative identifies the wealth as a garden at al-Ṭāʾif whose produce continued through both winter and summer.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p404/r7.anchor: والرابع أنه بستان كان له بالطائف لا ينقطع خيره شتاء ولا صيفا قاله قاتل

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#2/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#2/r3.claim: “Extended wealth” means abundant and ample wealth.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#2/r3.anchor: أي: واسعا كثيرا قيل: ألف دينار.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#2/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#2/r4.speaker: قيل
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#2/r4.claim: One reported estimate of his extended wealth is one thousand dinars.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#2/r4.anchor: أي: واسعا كثيرا قيل: ألف دينار.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#2/r5.speaker: قيل
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#2/r5.claim: Another reported estimate of his extended wealth is one hundred thousand dinars.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#2/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#2/r6.speaker: قيل
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p265#2/r6.claim: A further view identifies the extended wealth as cultivable land from which produce is taken.

JISHUMI:v10p7156/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7156/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7156/r10.claim: The passage is said to concern al-Walid ibn al-Mughira al-Makhzumi, wealthy with sons and called al-Wahid among his people, according to Ibn Amir.
JISHUMI:v10p7156/r10.anchor: قيل: نزلت هذه الآيات في الوليد بن المغيرة المخزومي، وكان له مال وبنون، قال ابن عامر: وكان يسمى الوحيد في قومه،

JISHUMI:v10p7156/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7156/r11.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7156/r11.claim: In the story, al-Walid rejects calling Muhammad a soothsayer, poet, or madman, then chooses “magician” and says the Qur’an separates families.
JISHUMI:v10p7156/r11.anchor: ثم اختلفوا، فقيل: إنه أتى قريشا في ناديها، وقال: هذا الموسم، والناس يسألون عن محمد،

JISHUMI:v10p7160/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r1.claim: Abundant blessings make disobedience toward the Benefactor more serious.
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r1.anchor: تدل الآيات على أن كثرة النعم توجب عظم عصيان المنعم.

JISHUMI:v10p7160/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r2.claim: God grants blessings to unbelievers, contrary to the Mujbira.
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r2.anchor: وتدل على أن لله تعالى على الكفار نعما، خلاف قول المجبرة.

JISHUMI:v10p7160/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r3.claim: Worldly conditions and goods are blessings from God.
JISHUMI:v10p7160/r3.anchor: وتدل على أن أحوال الدنيا من نعمه تعالى.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r7.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r7.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r7.claim: ممدود means extensive and abundant, or increased by growth, as a river is enlarged by another stream.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r7.anchor: من مد الهر ومد نهره آخر

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r8.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r8.speaker: قيل
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r8.claim: One report says his wealth included crops, livestock, and trade.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r8.anchor: قيل : كان له الزرع والضرع والتجارة

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r9.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r9.speaker: ابن عباس
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r9.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās identifies his wealth as various property between Mecca and al-Ṭāʾif.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r9.anchor: وعن ابن عباس : هو ما كان له بين مكة والطائف

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r10.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r10.speaker: قيل
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r10.claim: Another report describes a garden in al-Ṭāʾif whose fruit continued through summer and winter.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r10.anchor: وقيل : كان له بستان بالطائف لا ينقطع ثماره

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r11.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r11.speaker: قيل
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r11.claim: Reports estimate his wealth at one thousand, four thousand, nine thousand, or one million mithqāls.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r12.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r12.speaker: ابن جريج
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r12.claim: Ibn Jurayj says his wealth yielded income month after month.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p649/r12.anchor: وعن ابن جريج : غلة شهر بشهر

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas takes the extended wealth to be one thousand dinars.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r6.anchor: أحدها : ألف دينار , قاله ابن عباس .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r7.speaker: سفيان
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r7.claim: Sufyan takes it to be four thousand dinars.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r7.anchor: الثاني : أربعة الآف دينار , قاله سفيان .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r8.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r8.claim: Qatada takes it to be six thousand dinars.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r8.anchor: الثالث : ستة الآف دينار , قاله قتادة .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r9.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r9.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r9.claim: Mujahid gives one hundred thousand dinars as an interpretation.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r9.anchor: الرابع : مائة ألف دينار , قاله مجاهد .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r10.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r10.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r10.claim: Another report from Mujahid identifies the wealth with land called Mithaq.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r10.anchor: الخامس : أنها أرض يقال لها ميثاق , وهذا مروي عن مجاهد أيضا .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r11.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r11.speaker: عمر
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r11.claim: Umar says it is income arriving month after month.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r11.anchor: السادس : أنها غلة شهر بشهر , قاله عمر رضي الله عنه .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r12.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r12.speaker: السدي
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r12.claim: Al-Suddi says it is wealth that does not cease in winter or summer.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r12.anchor: السابع : أنه الذي لا ينقطع شتاء ولا صيفا , قاله السدي .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r13.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r13.speaker: ابن بحر
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r13.claim: Ibn Bahr identifies it as livestock whose grazing extends across the land.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r13.anchor: الثامن : أنها الأنعام التي يمتد سيرها في أقطار الأرض للمرعى والسعة , قاله ابن بحر .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r14.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r14.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r14.claim: A further possibility is wealth spanning crops, trade, and livestock, each source supporting the next.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r14.anchor: ويحتمل تاسعا : أن سيتوعب وجوه المكاسب فيجمع بين زيادة الزراعة وكسب التجارة ونتاج المواشي فيمد بعضها ببعض

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r15.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r15.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r15.claim: Another possibility is self-renewing growth such as palms and trees.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p139/r15.anchor: ويحتمل عاشرا : أنه الذي يتكون نماؤه من أصله كالنخل والشجر .

MUQATIL:74:11-17/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:74:11-17/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:74:11-17/r2.claim: The extended wealth is al-Walid's orchard at Taif, whose benefits continue through winter and summer.
MUQATIL:74:11-17/r2.anchor: { وجعلت له مالا ممدودا } [آية: 12] يعني بالمال بستانه الذي له بالطائف، والممدود الذي لا ينقطع خيره شتاء ولا صيفا

NASAFI-FULL:v4p295/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p295/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p295/r1.claim: His wealth was abundant or continually growing; it included crops, livestock, and trade.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p295/r1.anchor: مبسوطا كثيرا أو ممدودا بالنماء وكان له الزرع والضرع والتجارة

NASAFI-FULL:v4p295/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p295/r2.speaker: مجاهد
NASAFI-FULL:v4p295/r2.claim: Mujahid reports that al-Walid had one hundred thousand dinars.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p295/r2.anchor: وعن مجاهد كان له مائة ألف دينار

NASAFI-FULL:v4p295/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p295/r3.speaker: مجاهد
NASAFI-FULL:v4p295/r3.claim: Mujahid also reports that he had land at Taif whose produce never ceased.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p295/r3.anchor: وعنه أن له أرضا بالطائف لا ينقطع ثمرها

QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r10.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r10.claim: Ibn Abbas lists camels, horses, livestock, gardens, and male and female slaves between Mecca and Taif.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r10.anchor: وهو ما كان للوليد بين مكة والطائف من الإبل والحجور والنعم والجنان

QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r11.speaker: مجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r11.claim: Mujahid, Saʿid ibn Jubayr, and Ibn Abbas give annual income of one thousand dinars.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r11.anchor: غلة ألف دينار قاله سعيد بن جبير وابن عباس أيضا

QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r12.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r12.claim: Qatada estimates six thousand dinars; Sufyan al-Thawri and Qatada give four thousand, and Sufyan also gives one million.

QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r13.speaker: مقاتل
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r13.claim: Muqatil says al-Walid owned an orchard whose produce never ceased in winter or summer.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r13.anchor: مقاتل: كان له بستان لا ينقطع خيره شتاء ولا صيفا

QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r14.speaker: عمر
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r14.claim: Umar interprets the wealth as monthly income, month after month.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r14.anchor: وقال عمر رضي الله عنه: { وجعلت له مالا ممدودا } غلة شهر بشهر

QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r15.speaker: النعمان بن سالم
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r15.claim: Nuʿman ibn Salim says it means cultivated land.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r15.anchor: النعمان بن سالم: أرضا يزرع فيها

QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r16.speaker: القشيري
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r16.claim: Al-Qushayri prefers recurring income such as crops, livestock, and trade.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:11-13/r16.anchor: القشيري: والأظهر أنه إشارة إلى ما لا ينقطع رزقه، بل يتوالى
